info.prompt: Top-down tactical view of the full neural cathedral arena mid-match: gothic arches of bone-circuitry frame the shrinking safe zone, where neon cyan waypoints mark surviving players. An artificer's dice roll sends cog-shaped shockwaves through the tiles, disrupting a bard's combo rhythm visible as distorted musical staff lines in the air. The HUD's class badges glow with respective colors—paladin gold, rogue magenta—while the void black background swims with synaptic data flows and alchemical amber runes.
